review_type: Fresh independent visual inspection of actual screenshots
identity_blinding: Source identity unblinded for this component review.
scope: Game8 physical mechanisms / complete3Dscene, round-05. Five captures compared directly with two supplied Room 4 mechanism references.

method.limits: Static screenshots support visual judgments only. They do not establish animation, hit target usability, mechanism simulation, or a chronological regression.

verdicts.new_inspection_framing_scope: The entire circular active mechanism fits clear of the HUD on desktop and phone. This does not assert that the complete door/cabinet casing is visible; its upper and lower extremities are cropped.
verdicts.physical_depth_and_housing: PASS for visible depth and attachment; PARTIAL for convincing mechanical transmission.
verdicts.room_state_visual_coherence: PASS with focus-state communication issue and sparse escape destination.
verdicts.commercial_finish_scope: Below the supplied Room 4 safe and workbench mechanism finish. Accepting camera framing does not pass the commercial reference bar.

framing_findings.finding: The complete ring, all visible peripheral blocks, front wheel, central boss, link rods and small gears fit within the scene. The top title and inspect label, upper-right toolbar, and lower progress HUD do not cover the circular mechanism. The oblique view exposes the raised right-hand rim and the door around it.

At 390 by 844 the entire circular mechanism remains on screen between the inspect label and lower HUD. It is roughly 220 pixels wide. The broad form and rods remain identifiable, but fine ticks, fasteners and gear teeth are too small for detailed examination in this single view. Door top/bottom and surrounding casing are cropped.
framing_findings.verdict: PASS for framing, limited for fine inspection

physical_depth_findings: The center wheel sits in front of the backing plate; the thick perimeter rim shows a side edge; peripheral blocks and several pivots have distinct depth. The object reads as modeled relief attached to a substantial door.
Several rods visibly reach pivots or peripheral blocks, giving the assembly a physical connection vocabulary.

A continuous gear-to-bolt transmission is not obvious in the still. Small gears behind the wheel read as separately placed elements more than as a clearly meshing train. The screenshot does not prove they are mechanically wrong, but it does not communicate their operation convincingly.

The current view demonstrates layered surface construction more strongly than the full volume of the housing. The safe reference presents two complete faces, corners, feet and multiple axes of mechanism at once.

reference_comparison.observations: The reference makes the enclosure believable through complete box volume, corner straps, rivets, feet, recessed ornamental panels, toothed racks and mechanisms on two faces. Wear is varied across surfaces and concentrated around edges and fittings. The candidate has a clear circular assembly and supporting door, but coarser edges, simpler repeated blocks/fasteners, broad speckled rust and limited joint-specific detail.

The reference separates copper, dark metal, polished caps, ribbed coils, collars, pipe elbows, fasteners and structural feet. Its overlapping components and precise mating surfaces show how parts occupy and connect through space. The candidate separates foreground wheel from backplate, but most metal stays within a narrow bronze/dark palette and the rods, gears and casing lack this level of tailored connection and material detail.

room_state_findings.finding: The same desk, chair, bookshelves, windows, side mechanisms and central doorway remain spatially consistent. The closed circular vault becomes an open door at left of the central opening, and the avatar is in that opening. The 8/8 count, completed lock list, full progress line and escape message agree visually.
The revealed destination is a plain gray gridded area, with little depth or scene-specific detail. The completed state is readable, but the final reveal has limited visual payoff.

The in-scene target reads INSPECT · FINAL VAULT while the desktop Field notes shows only 01 · Switch Network with FOCUS. The inspected object and side-panel focus are not reconciled visibly. The phone omits that list, avoiding the contradiction there but also supplying less context.

The cream/brass/cyan floating Archivist has a readable silhouette and belongs to the same palette. The close shot reveals simple finger strips, broad unvaried shell shading and basic joint geometry; it is recognizable, but does not match the supplied references in asset finish.

current_shortcomings_and_regression_limi.chronological_regression: Not established: only round-05 and the two reference images were inspected. No previous round was read, and no chronological claim is made.
visible_current_shortcomings: Phone preserves the full mechanism at the cost of very small part detail; fine inspection cannot be demonstrated from the supplied static phone shot.
Door housing extremities remain cropped even though the complete active circular mechanism fits.
Desktop Final Vault inspection is paired with Switch Network focus in Field notes.
Room composition leaves a large dark ceiling band, while playable objects cluster at the rear and sides; the central vault is relatively small in the wide shot.
The result destination is visually sparse, and close views expose simplified asset construction and broad procedural-looking surface treatment.

biggest_remaining_gap: Authored asset and material finish: believable mating parts, refined edge profiles, readable transmission, differentiated metals and wear tied to construction. More objects or another camera adjustment alone would not close the reference gap.
priorities: Keep the accepted desktop and phone framing. Refine the vault assembly with visible bearings/collars, seated fasteners, more deliberate bevels and readable relationships between wheel, gear train, rods and bolts.
Replace broadly uniform rust and flat gold faces with differentiated metal response and construction-aware wear, while retaining enough lighting contrast to separate overlapping parts.
Align the visible inspection target with side-panel focus, and give the opened doorway a more intentional destination and lighting treatment.
